workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.include_dossier: Include private dossier elements in this message
workspace.include_pdf_page: Include this private PDF page and its comments in the selected CLI request
workspace.library_private_note: Pages remain private source material. Import does not establish campaign facts.
workspace.create_hint: Import a local PDF or add campaign records.
workspace.stale_quote: This passage changed in the document; review the anchor.
workspace.locate_quote: Show this passage in the document
workspace.prompt_too_long: This message is too long. Shorten the current draft before adding the comment.
workspace.turn_interrupted: The local CLI turn was interrupted. Send a new message to retry.
workspace.chat_start: Work through the campaign in conversation
workspace.chat_hint: Choose Codex or Claude Code, select a document, and ask for a direction or revision. Suggestions remain drafts until you decide.
workspace.playbook_none: Start freely or choose a playbook
workspace.playbook_explore_prompt: Using the open document, propose two distinct directions for the campaign. Separate established facts from invention and name the choice the GM needs to make.
workspace.playbook_revise_prompt: Address the comments on the open document. If it is a product document, edit the file in the draft checkout and summarize the diff. If it is a campaign record, propose exact replacement wording for GM review; do not change canon.
workspace.playbook_prepare_prompt: From the open document and established facts, draft a playable situation for the next session: stakes, NPC intentions, plausible player branches, references, and what is still missing.
workspace.playbook_conflict_prompt: Compare the open document with established facts. Identify any contradiction with its sources and ask the GM only the targeted question needed to resolve it.
workspace.prompt_hint: Discuss a scene, ask a question, or request a revision…
workspace.send_notice: Only Send calls the selected signed-in CLI. That call may use its plan or credits; replies cannot change canon directly.
error.quote_missing: The quoted passage is not in this document.
error.provider_missing: The selected CLI is not installed.
error.agent_busy: An assistant is already working. Try again when it finishes.
workspace.select_lines: Select any passage to comment on exactly that text. Click a line number to select its full line.
workspace.product_explain: Product design documents, separate from campaign material.
workspace.export_copy: Downloaded copy; edits do not sync back.
workspace.skill_hint: Choose a local skill to add it to your message.
workspace.draft_ready: This draft can be applied after review.
workspace.draft_applied: This change is already present in the document.
workspace.draft_conflict: The document changed since the draft was created; reconcile before applying.
error.draft_conflict: The document changed since the draft; application refused.
workspace.skill_instruction: Use the __SKILL__ skill for this request.
workspace.draft_unchanged: Draft ready to edit in an editor or with the CLI.
workspace.draft_invalid: Invalid format: edit only the text between the field markers.
error.draft_format: Edit only the text between the Situation and Alternatives field markers.
error.pdf_private: Keep licensed PDFs outside the source repository.
error.pdf_too_large: This PDF is too large for the local pilot (150 MB maximum).
error.pdf_tools_missing: Install the local pdfinfo and pdftotext commands to import PDFs.
error.pdf_extract_failed: Could not extract every PDF page. No pages were imported.
bible.title: Campaign bible
bible.review_hint: Point to an element in the bible to comment on it. Links are active again when you leave this mode.
bible.changed: This element changed since the comment.
bible.truth_empty: No played session has been recorded. This view describes the published scenario’s proposed starting point; player choices and table facts remain to be established.
bible.truth_facts: {count} table fact(s) established. Other elements in this view describe the published scenario and remain proposals.
bible.network_alt: Diagram linking people, places, and stakes
bible.footnote: Illustrations and maps extracted from the private campaign PDF. Sheets can be edited in your Markdown editor.
sheet.storage: Private Markdown file · open in another editor
workspace.sheet_draft_hint: Edit this private draft in an editor or through the connected CLI. Only acceptance changes the campaign sheet.
workspace.sheet_draft_invalid: The draft has broken references or no Markdown title.
workspace.include_sheet: Include this private sheet in the next CLI prompt and create or reuse its editable draft
workspace.sheet_draft_access: An existing draft remains accessible in this campaign's CLI worktree after this turn.
error.campaign_draft_invalid: The proposed campaign sheet has broken references or invalid Markdown.
